reviewer: rooms_qa independent plus root Product Design IAB review

hierarchy.rationale: The hero has one dominant concept and one primary action; article and workspace headings separate the three tasks clearly.

proportions.rationale: Photography keeps its full source composition; the revised dark gallery uses available height and the tablet landscape fits both edges.

rhythm.rationale: Spacing, editorial dividers and section numbering give a consistent reading rhythm across the paper surface.

density.rationale: The reading column is comfortable; the mobile evidence panel repeats several title layers before the factual metadata. Next action: consolidate the fragment/title introduction on mobile without removing context or source metadata.
density.nextAction: Compactar introduccion de fragmento y titulos en radiografia movil sin eliminar contexto ni fuentes.

depth.rationale: Navy proposal, paper reading surface and dark gallery make context changes clear; restrained backdrop separates inspection from the proposal.

surfaceEconomy.rationale: Work is presented as photography, reading columns and divided rows instead of stacked card containers or invented dashboard metrics.

visualImpact.rationale: The campaign photography creates a distinct focal point and the large typographic concept remains recognizable on mobile.

typography.rationale: Bricolage heading and Poppins body are actually loaded; article copy remains legible, with deliberate hierarchy and wrapping at 200% text.

color.rationale: Navy, paper and teal distinguish hierarchy; DOM text passes automated contrast, and gallery captions were independently measured at 9.82:1. Embedded raster lettering has a separate unverified pixel-contrast limitation.

iconography.rationale: Directional arrows and close icons have narrow, clear roles, with accessible names and adequate interaction targets.

responsive.rationale: Headers and tabs wrap, editorial content reflows, and all three photo formats fit the inspector across the four widths. The 1024 landscape defect was corrected and rechecked.

motion.rationale: Action feedback is visible without distracting from the proposal; focus restoration and reduced-motion flows remain usable.

fidelity.rationale: The implementation matches the task's dominant creative stage, full editorial reading, contextual radiography and separate operation workspace. This is contract fidelity, not a claim of pixel identity with an unavailable approved canvas.

genericTemplateResistance.rationale: The room centers actual campaign work and contextual decisions; the operator view uses compact room rows and explicit capabilities rather than decorative KPI cards.

claim: Local candidate; contract fidelity, not pixel identity against an approved canvas
